title: Telecom Security Engineer (T&M basis contractual role)
description:
Telecom Security Engineer Location : Noida Employement Type : Contract Salary : Pay will be on hourly basis Job Summary We are looking for a Telecom Security Engineer with strong hands-on knowledge of 2G/3G/4G/5G networks, RAN, EPC/5G Core, IMS/VoLTE, telecom signaling protocols, and telecom security. The candidate should understand telecom network elements, their security requirements, and logging capabilities. The role will work closely with Telecom Network/OEM, Cybersecurity, SOC, and SIEM teams to enable centralized security monitoring of telecom infrastructure. Role positioning: SIEM knowledge is highly preferred; however, the primary requirement is strong Telecom domain expertise with an understanding of security monitoring and log integration. Key Responsibilities Understand end-to-end 2G/3G/4G/5G architecture, including RAN, EPC, 5G Core, IMS/VoLTE, and OSS/BSS. Work with telecom network elements including HLR, HSS, MSC, MME, SGW, PGW, AMF, SMF, UPF, PCRF/PCF, SBC, and IMS components. Apply knowledge of SS7, Diameter, GTP, SIP, and 5G Core/SBA protocols. Assess telecom security threats and vulnerabilities across Core, RAN, IMS, signaling, roaming, and interconnect environments. Identify security-relevant logs and events generated by telecom network elements and applications. Coordinate with OEM/vendor teams to enable appropriate security logging on telecom devices. Support onboarding of telecom devices and applications into the SIEM platform. Coordinate connectivity, routing, firewall, and log-forwarding prerequisites with relevant teams. Work with SIEM engineers on log validation, parsing, normalization, field mapping, and integration troubleshooting. Identify security-logging gaps and support remediation of missing, delayed, or incorrectly parsed events. Assist SOC/SIEM teams in defining telecom-specific security monitoring and detection use cases. Maintain telecom device inventory, logging requirements, integration details, and supporting technical documentation. Mandatory Skills Strong understanding of 4G LTE and 5G architecture, including EPC and 5G Core. Knowledge of RAN architecture, IMS/VoLTE, and major Telecom Core network elements. Strong working knowledge of SS7, Diameter, GTP, and SIP. Understanding of telecom signaling security, network security, and security events. Hands-on telecom device and network troubleshooting experience. Knowledge of IP networking, TCP/IP, routing, DNS, and firewall fundamentals. Understanding of telecom network-element logs and device logging capabilities. Ability to collaborate across Telecom Network, OEM, Cybersecurity, SOC, and SIEM teams. SIEM Knowledge - Highly Preferred The candidate does not need to be a dedicated SIEM administrator, but should preferably understand: SIEM architecture and security-monitoring concepts. Telecom log-source onboarding and log collection/forwarding. Syslog and API-based integration concepts. Log parsing, normalization, validation, and security-event field mapping. Log-integration troubleshooting and data-quality validation. SIEM correlation, detection-use-case requirements, and SOC monitoring needs. Working knowledge of Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, FortiSIEM, or an equivalent SIEM platform. Preferred OEM Experience Ericsson | Nokia | Huawei | Cisco | Mavenir | Oracle Preferred Qualifications Bachelors degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or an equivalent discipline. 5-10 years of relevant Telecom or Telecom Security experience. Experience in Telecom Core, Network Security, Telecom SOC, or security-monitoring environments. Telecom 4G/5G, networking, cybersecurity, or SIEM-related certifications are advantageous.

Attend and participate in cybersecurity projects and the change management process. This includes interacting with business units and technical teams to understand what is coming and how their projects can be more secure from the beginning.
